limitations_and_boundaries: The detailed biochemical mechanisms by which cytoskeletal tension regulates YAP/TAZ await further characterization.
The study primarily uses in vitro cell culture models; in vivo relevance remains to be fully established.
The bioinformatic analysis was performed on a specific MEC dataset; generalizability to other cell types may vary.
The role of YAP/TAZ in other mechanosensitive processes beyond differentiation and survival was not explored.
